text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Good work. I took the liberty of observing your training session.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Thorough warm-ups, followed by a disciplined routine of fundamentals...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: You covered crucial details that are all too often neglected.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Keep up that standard next time as well.
